title: Promote a model without losing the fleet
description: Select a rollout ring, artifact state, connectivity condition, reconciliation rule, and injected failure. The lab shows whether promotion should proceed, pause, or roll back.
modelNote: The gates are policy examples, not universal thresholds. Production thresholds must come from validated task risk, fleet diversity, and incident evidence.

rings.label: Canary
rings.detail: Representative hardware, geography, and network cohorts.

rings.label: Site ring
rings.detail: One bounded facility with an on-site rollback owner.

rings.label: Fleet
rings.detail: All eligible sites after compatibility and outcome evidence clears.

artifacts.label: Signed and compatible
artifacts.detail: Digest, signer, model signature, runtime, and opset match the cohort contract.

artifacts.label: Signed, schema break
artifacts.detail: The artifact is authentic, but the input signature no longer matches device features.

artifacts.label: Unsigned artifact
artifacts.detail: The model bytes arrived without trusted signer and provenance evidence.

artifacts.label: Expired update metadata
artifacts.detail: The payload was signed, but update metadata is expired and cannot prove freshness.

connectivity.label: Online
connectivity.detail: Commands, policy, and aggregated evidence are current.

connectivity.label: Intermittent
connectivity.detail: The site reconnects every few hours and buffers bounded observations.

connectivity.label: Long partition
connectivity.detail: The site has been disconnected for 30 hours and cannot refresh rollout intent.

syncPolicies.label: Field-level authority
syncPolicies.detail: Cloud owns desired model and policy; site owns admission; devices append observations and retain safety overrides.

syncPolicies.label: Last write wins
syncPolicies.detail: The largest wall-clock timestamp overwrites state regardless of field owner.

syncPolicies.label: Cloud overwrites all
syncPolicies.detail: Reconnect applies cloud snapshots over device observations and local safety state.

failures.label: Healthy
failures.detail: Readiness, task outcomes, drift, and telemetry are within the selected ring budget.

failures.label: Runtime crash loop
failures.detail: The new runtime repeatedly fails on one accelerator generation.

failures.label: Silent task drift
failures.detail: Infrastructure is healthy, but task outcome and feature distributions diverge.

failures.label: Telemetry blind spot
failures.detail: A collector policy drops model version and task outcome evidence.

failures.label: Fallback incompatible
failures.detail: The previous model remains cached, but its feature contract no longer matches the local pipeline.
